display.title: The Hall of Legends
description: Every great foe gives its first slayer (and everyone fighting within 96 blocks) a relic and a &etrophy&r -
a display block for your base. Great bosses give a Starforged Heart, lesser ones an Ancient Core.
The reward is once per player, so summonable bosses (Wither, Warden, re-summoned Dragon) cannot be farmed for relics.
&7Each quest completes when you are credited with the kill (also retroactively).
&bWhy it matters:&r Explains how first-defeat relics, trophies and hearts work.
